title: Streit eskaliert – rassistische Beleidigung und wechselseitige Körperverletzungen

extraction.summaryEn: After an argument in Prenzlauer Berg, a 49-year-old woman allegedly insulted another woman on racist grounds and several people were involved in assaults. Staatsschutz has taken over the investigation, and one of the suspects allegedly drove into a man blocking her car.
